info.name: BG7 - HMS Integration
info.description:
BG7 collection. Validates inbound API-key authentication and the read-only `/api/hms/*` façade introduced in `apps/api/src/modules/hms-integration`.

Folder run order:
1. **00 Read Me** — variables + run order.
2. **A. Auth & Context Baseline** — owner JWT login (R12) + `/api/auth/me` (R14).
3. **B. Mint Keys (org-wide + branch-scoped + revoked)** — uses the existing M39 `POST /api/dev/api-keys` surface, which BG7 extended with optional `branchId`. The plaintext key is captured to a collection variable exactly once.
4. **C. HMS Auth (negative cases)** — missing key / unknown key / revoked key all return 401.
5. **D. HMS Whoami + Branches** — proves org-wide vs branch-scoped tenancy isolation.
6. **E. HMS Sales surface** — `/orders`, `/payments`, `/refunds`, `/sales/summary`.
7. **F. HMS Hospitality surface** — `/reservations`, `/events`, `/event-bookings`.
8. **G. HMS Catalog/Inventory** — `/menu`, `/inventory`.
9. **H. HMS Operations** — `/shifts`, `/accounting/accounts`, `/accounting/invoices`, `/accounting/vendor-bills`.
10. **I. Access Journal** — `/access-logs` proves every prior request was journaled.

⚠️ **Re-import required after any script change.** Postman caches pre-request and test scripts at import time.

item.name: README - run order, variables, locked rules

request.description:
## Run order
1. **A. Auth Baseline** — login owner + /api/auth/me.
2. **B. Mint Keys** — org-wide + branch-scoped + revoked.
3. **C. HMS Auth (negative)** — 401 without key / unknown key / revoked key.
4. **D. Whoami + Branches** — tenancy isolation.
5. **E. Sales surface** — orders / payments / refunds / sales summary.
6. **F. Hospitality** — reservations / events / event-bookings.
7. **G. Catalog / Inventory** — menu / inventory.
8. **H. Operations** — shifts / accounting/{accounts,invoices,vendor-bills}.
9. **I. Access Journal** — /api/hms/access-logs.

## Auto-populated variables
- `accessToken`, `orgId`, `branchId` (R12/R14).
- `hmsOrgKey`, `hmsOrgKeyId`, `hmsBranchKey`, `hmsBranchKeyId`, `hmsRevokedKey`, `hmsRevokedKeyId` (folder B).

## Locked rules verified
- New `ApiKeyAuthGuard` — header `x-api-key` (or `Authorization: ApiKey <key>`), SHA-256 lookup, status=ACTIVE, not expired.
- Synthetic principal `apikey:<id>` granted `hms:read:*`.
- `IntegrationAccessLog` row written for every reached request (best-effort).
- Branch-scoped key forces results to its single branch; org-wide key sees all.
- Read-only — no POST/PATCH/DELETE on `/api/hms/*`.

exec: if (j.refreshToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', j.refreshToken); if (pm.environment && pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('refreshToken', j.refreshToken); }
if (orgId) { pm.collectionVariables.set('orgId', orgId); if (pm.environment && pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('orgId', orgId); }
if (branchId) { pm.collectionVariables.set('branchId', branchId); if (pm.environment && pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('branchId', branchId); }
if (pm.environment && pm.environment.name) { pm.environment.set('hmsOrgKey', j.key); pm.environment.set('hmsOrgKeyId', j.id); }
if (pm.environment && pm.environment.name) { pm.environment.set('hmsBranchKey', j.key); pm.environment.set('hmsBranchKeyId', j.id); }
if (pm.environment && pm.environment.name) { pm.environment.set('hmsRevokedKey', j.key); pm.environment.set('hmsRevokedKeyId', j.id); }
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('code', () => pm.expect((j.code || (j.message && j.message.code) || (j.error && j.error.code))).to.eql('API_KEY_INVALID'));
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('code', () => pm.expect((j.code || (j.message && j.message.code) || (j.error && j.error.code))).to.eql('API_KEY_REVOKED'));
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('paginated', () => { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('total'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('items'); pm.expect(j.limit).to.eql(5); });
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('shape', () => { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('totals'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('window'); });
